title: Convoy Union
lesson: Shared convoy approvals and independent economies.

objectives.text: Western Command loses its final HQ.
Eastern Command loses its final HQ.
Preserve all six original convoy trucks.

scenario_exceptions.detail: Completed convoy one unlocks exactly two authored repair depots, one per human owner. Repairs still cost the owning player credits. Convoy trucks are script-controlled original cargo actors and never grant combat units.
Finite scripted enemy column 1: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (100,52).
Finite scripted enemy column 2: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (83,20).
Finite scripted enemy column 3: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (100,52).
Finite scripted enemy column 4: 3 rifles; normal adds 1 car, hard also adds 1 tank. Only enemy timing is scaled. Entry (83,20).

subtitles.speaker: Joint Command
subtitles.text: Two independent allied economies escort three sequential two-truck convoys. Choose the northern or southern route at each checkpoint. Either commander can Hold; after a manual hold both must approve Advance. The visible countdown protects route decisions. A completed convoy unlocks one forward repair position for each owner, not free combat reinforcements. At least one truck from each convoy must arrive.

subtitles.speaker: Convoy control
subtitles.text: Convoy one is ready. Approve Advance, or Hold while an escort clears the chosen branch.

subtitles.speaker: Convoy control
subtitles.text: First delivery complete. Two separately owned forward repair depots are now available. Convoy two is ready.

subtitles.speaker: Convoy control
subtitles.text: Second delivery complete. Prepare the final convoy and review the route before approving Advance.

subtitles.speaker: Watch
subtitles.text: Hostile column 1 is approaching the eastern road. Expected entry varies with difficulty; screen the marked approach.

subtitles.speaker: Joint Command
subtitles.text: The joint operation is complete. Review both commanders’ losses and convoy decisions.

subtitles.speaker: Joint Command
subtitles.text: The joint requirements can no longer be met. Restore the last shared checkpoint.
